shots.focal_element: Presenter seated at a wooden desk facing camera; a two-line kinetic caption overlays the lower half mid-shot
shots.typography: Very heavy, wide/extended sans in white, sentence case, two centered lines, tight tracking, slight forward slant; small decorative accents around it (four-point sparkle, starburst, short horizontal dashes). Font guess (low confidence): an extended grotesk such as Monument Extended.
shots.what_happens: Presenter introduces himself and Apollo (w0-w4) in a medium-wide studio shot with a laptop, plant and ring light. Around 1.5 s a large, ghosted version of the caption scales/fades in and settles by 2.0 s into 'Most up-to-date lead database', timed to the spoken phrase (w10-w15); the accents pop in by 2.5 s, the caption shrinks slightly around 3.5-4.5 s and is gone by 5.0 s. The rest of the shot (w17-w30) is plain presenter; the 8.0 s frame already shows a tighter framing, likely the start of the next shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a full-bleed presenter clip, show a two-line extended-sans white caption that scales down from about 130% with a blur-to-sharp fade over ~0.4 s when its phrase is spoken, pop small sparkle/starburst/dash accents around it 0.3 s later, then fade it out after ~3 s.

shots.focal_element: Presenter in a tighter punch-in framing, surrounded by floating white UI cards (prospect profile, sequence steps, AI email assistant)
on_screen_text: Hi Alissa, Glad to connect. Looks like you're growing the account management team quite a bit right now. Let's find some time to talk about your goals and how
shots.typography: Product-UI typography: clean geometric/neo-grotesk sans, medium-bold names and card titles, regular-weight grey secondary lines, small bold labels on blue pill buttons, sentence/title case, normal tracking. Email body is typed on progressively (keyframe shows a partial sentence ending 'how').
shots.what_happens: Cut to a tighter crop of the presenter, hands clasped. UI cards pop in on cue with the VO: a prospect profile card top-left at about 9.0 s ('find the right prospects', w36-w39), a three-step sequence card right at about 10.0 s ('engage with them at the right time', w40-w46), and an 'AI email assistant' card left at about 11.5 s ('using the right message', w47-w50) whose body text types on through the rest of the shot. All three cards stay on screen through w51-w64 while the presenter finishes the platform pitch; the cards appear to drift slightly.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a punched-in presenter clip, pop three rounded white UI cards with soft drop shadows into the empty corners (scale 0.9 to 1 with fade, ~0.3 s each), each triggered on its VO keyword, and typewrite the email-assistant body text at roughly 20 characters per second.

shots.focal_element: Black Apollo.io wordmark centered on a warm yellow background with large lighter concentric circles
shots.typography: Logo wordmark: bold geometric sans, lowercase 'pollo.io' with a stylised triangular 'A' mark, tight tracking.
shots.what_happens: Hard cut to a full-bleed yellow brand card in the speech gap between w64 and w65. At 16.5 s only a stroke of the 'A' is visible; by 17.0 s the wordmark has assembled (letters still resolving) and is complete by 17.5 s. Lighter yellow circles sweep/expand from the right and a thin white arc crosses the lower left while the logo holds. Music hits are detected at 16.42 s and 17.84 s (x001, x002); there is no voice-over in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: On a flat yellow background, draw on the logo's 'A' stroke then mask-reveal the remaining letters left to right over ~0.5 s, while two lighter-yellow circles scale out from the right edge with ease-out over ~2 s and a thin white arc slides across the lower left; hold the lockup ~2 s.
